analyst_view.overall: Go Ahead Eagles (8th, 17 pts) host Fortuna Sittard (7th, 20 pts), who have drawn four of their last five. Fortuna are badly hit: Ole Romeny, Edouard Michut, Daley Sinkgraven, Lequincio Zeefuik and Rodrigo Guth were all out for the 2-2 with Telstar (club news site Fortuna Online), and an injury tracker still lists all of them, plus Ramazan Bayram, out until December or January; the brief lists no Fortuna absences, so the numbers do not see them, although their recent momentum partly reflects the weaker side. Fortuna Online also reports (18 November) that coach Danny Buijs will not extend his contract. Go Ahead won 1-0 at Excelsior last time with Jasper Cillessen in goal; Marsman and Saathof are out as the numbers know. Referee Martijn Vos (4.6 cards a game) is already a large part of the cards number.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Fortuna are without forwards Romeny and Zeefuik and midfielders Michut and Sinkgraven, none of whom the numbers take off, and they have scored only 8 in their last six (partly counted in momentum). I trim Fortuna's attack and land at about 2.9 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, already cut a little for Fortuna's low recent corner count (20 in six). Go Ahead's settled side (same XI two games running) should press in the usual way, and Fortuna's absences are already showing in that low corner count, so I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards: Martijn Vos's very high card rate (+40%) pushes it up, while Go Ahead's 4 cards in their last six and Fortuna's low count pull it down, all already counted. Buijs's contract news is unlikely to change how either side plays, so I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots. Fortuna's shooting is down recently (64 in six) and they are missing several attacking players the numbers don't know about, so I lean lower to about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. With Romeny, Zeefuik and Michut out, Fortuna should test Go Ahead's keeper less than the numbers assume; about 9.3.
